thumbnails.name: Impacto (assunto grande + texto curto)
thumbnails.prompt: YouTube thumbnail, 16:9, one large clear subject on the left, dramatic rim light, saturated contrasting colors, bold 3-word title text "{{thumb_text}}" in thick sans-serif, high contrast, topic: {{title}}

thumbnails.name: Explicativo (ilustração limpa)
thumbnails.prompt: YouTube thumbnail, 16:9, clean {{style}} illustration explaining {{title}}, big readable text "{{thumb_text}}", simple background, three-color palette

thumbnails.name: Documentário (cinematográfico)
thumbnails.prompt: YouTube thumbnail, 16:9, cinematic documentary still about {{title}}, moody lighting, shallow depth of field, small elegant title "{{thumb_text}}"

thumbnails.name: Referência YouTube (lx79NjzOdz8)
thumbnails.prompt: YouTube thumbnail, 16:9, FOLLOW THE ATTACHED REFERENCE THUMBNAIL as the style model: same composition, framing, focal-point position, text size and placement, contrast, lighting and color palette. NEW subject and headline about {{title}}, with the headline "{{thumb_text}}" in bold outlined type and no other words. Do NOT copy the reference's text, logos, brands or real faces.
